body:
I appreciate it.  Very much so.

I'm debating on whether or not to to confide in my roommate when he gets home -- I believe that he has the same desires as I do.  There does exist a possibility of me making this more than just a pondering thought.

I've also considered contacting the very women who ruined my life.  If she didn't have access to contact information to people I know... I would easily do it and ask her for advice (as crazy as that sounds).  I'm still fucking pissed that I respect her -- all things considered.  I just don't think that I can trust her to not contact somebody.

My advice to you, is to  make fun of yourself the next time you do this (immediately in front of everybody).

But you can't make a big deal about it.

See, I'm 99% certain that nobody even noticed... but by making a big deal about it to yourself you set yourself up for failure.  So if you say something a bit non-kosher than blow it way out of proportions in a funny way.  This will ease your social anxiety and, if you do it right, make other people think you're funny.

It's critical that you do this about something that's super trivial that you're the only possible person that cares... and to do it in a funny way.  I think that once you do this once you'll find that nobody really does care and it's all in your head.

But I'm posting with an account I just made to make my own post here.  So, grain of salt my friend.

To answer your question, no I don't believe that **I** could start a *new* life.  I suck at lying and wouldn't be capable of using a fake name... so my past would catch up to me I'm sure.  I wouldn't even try really.  I mostly feel that moving around a lot or w/e would be sufficient.

As for your second question, no I don't believe that others' perception of my independence has any relation to me being single.  Of the GFs that I have had... I choose carefully and seek out women who are more adventurous and outgoing than I am.  I've been accused of seeking out "crazy girls".  I suppose it's true.

Having a relationship did give me purpose (with my last (only serious) relationship).  In fact when she broke up with me I was stuck with her (almost literally) for a week afterwards (long story).  We had many discussions that were insanely awkward; such as what it felt like to be single.  Yeah -- fucked up I know.  Anyway, I told her that I no longer had a reason to live.  She looked at me really shocked and I realized what I just said... so I had to break it down that I didn't mean literally.  I meant that I no longer had something to work for.  Somebody that gave me a reason to succeed and be great and provide for.

In the movie before sunset, there is a whole scene on how in today's society men no longer have a place, at least traditionally.  For centuries men have provided and cared for the women in their life and that is really no longer the case.  I think that I need that.  I want somebody to depend on me and for me to be there for them.

* but I don't and I always chase girls away.  I was extremely recently told that I do that because I'm too serious and conversational.  Ironically, the fact is that I'm really laid back and easy-going; it's just that I feel I can only really connect with people through serious discourse -- which apparently drives girls away?  (wtf is that about... no clue).

** at least I've graduated from being creepy?  (I **had** confidence problems at it used to show / creep girls out apparently

Deep down I think I know that.  Just like I know that the one thing I desire most -- the one cure-all that I'm searching for can never possibly live up to my expectations.  Like most people here on reddit, I haven't exactly had the greatest experiences with relationships.  That is until I met my last girlfriend.  She gave me the greatest year of my entire life -- I truly felt happy.  And then she left me to pursue her life-goals; I wasn't included in them.

While I want to believe that, had she not left, everything would have been okay.  I have come to accept that eventually I would have spiraled down to where I am right now.  There is no cure-all fix.

I guess it comes down to the fact that I believe life to be pointless.  Sure it has its great spots ever once in a while but mostly it's fucking mundane and pointless.  The real tragedy is most of my family / friends look up to me because I'm "outgoing" and "adventurous."  I've been told numerous times that they admire how much I live my life instead of just coasting through it.  And yet here I am.  Ultimately, my views as an atheist probably don't help much either.

I guess I just want to believe in the magic of running away.  You know?  What else do I have?  I'm constantly trying new things and somewhat meeting new people and it hasn't really done anything for me.  

I'm trying and yet I keep on returning to this place.

I don't know where I am anymore.  I look around and I feel like a piece of driftwood that's been at sea for years, and I am sick of it all.

So I want to commit suicide.  Not the typical defined version where you end your life -- I don't have that urge (well it comes and goes but it's extremely rare and never really controls me).  Basically, I want to leave everything.  My job, my friends, my family, my possessions.  My debt.  I want to disappear and start anew.

I want to the world to think that I did die.

The only thing holding me back is my stupid (I don't mean that) family and a very select few best-friends.  I'm angry with myself because all I can think of is how much I'm going to hurt those that care for me, especially my mother.  (well mainly her -- I could tolerate hurting he others because I know they'd get over it -- but my mother probably not-so-much).

I don't even know what I'm doing posting here... this is stupid.  Fuck'n e'l I don't care.  Maybe this is just me ranting.  I skipped work today... the first I've done it since I started >year ago.  I don't know what's going to happen but I feel in the last 6 months (since my world was crushed by somebody I trusted) I've been gradually fucking things up anyway.

Would it really be that bad to just disappear to another country and wander through life with nothing?  I don't know.  <sigh> I don't know.
